summary: Salix Group AB (publ) operates as a trading and distribution platform offering products to the construction and industrial sectors in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. The company offers products in three business areas including consumables trade, and agriculture; construction & packaging solutions; and home & fittings. It operates within hardware, consumables, input materials and packaging industry. It offers a broad range of products for home and garden, agriculture and forestry, and fittings and fastening products. The company was formerly known as Volati Trading and changed its name to Salix Group AB (publ) in 2021. Salix Group AB (publ) was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
